charts.interpretation: Products with the largest number of observed purchased order lines; occurrence does not measure revenue.
Shows whether typical orders contain few or many unique items; high values may be genuine, not errors.
Shows ordering frequency by dataset day code 0–6; original data does not explicitly define calendar weekday names.
Shows peak ordering hours in the chosen sample, useful for browsing trends.
Higher counts indicate more frequently purchased items from a department, not necessarily more spending.
Points beyond whiskers are potentially interesting large baskets; do not automatically remove them.
Exploratory linear correlations only; order rows repeat across items and this does not imply causal relationships.
